verdict.rationale: Kintsugi ships an MCP server, but it is explicitly documented as read-only access to public docs/OpenAPI spec for code-generation help — 'it never proxies calls to the API and never sees your credentials' — so it cannot be used to actually operate Kintsugi (create registrations, sync transactions, file taxes) via natural-language commands. No evidence of any chat/NL interface for operating the product itself.
